name: Goi kho bo
summary: Gỏi khô bò is the dried-beef salad on Con Market’s outdoor counters, beside ram cuốn cải, hủ tiếu, bánh canh, and hột vịt lộn.
howToEat: Order it at the outdoor counters.
where: Outdoor counters at Con Market. The 2019 account starts that row after 15:00.
